**Two sites are fixed; the new IESL site still loads the compromised `polyfill.io` domain.**

| Site | Status | Location |
|------|--------|----------|
| **diffusion** (dIESL) | Fixed | `_config.yml` → Cloudflare CDN |
| **dhruvdcoder.github.io** | Fixed | `_includes/scripts/mathjax.html` → Cloudflare CDN |
| **iesl.github.io** (new) | **Not fixed** | Still uses `polyfill.io` |
| **iesl.github.io_old** | N/A | No polyfill references |

### Fixed

**diffusion** — Cloudflare URL in config (same as [al-folio #2241](https://github.com/alshedivat/al-folio/pull/2241/changes)):

```577:580:/Users/dhruveshpatel/Files/IESL/diffusion/_config.yml
  polyfill:
    url:
      js: "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/polyfill/v{{version}}/polyfill.min.js?features=es6"
    version: "3"
```

**dhruvdcoder.github.io** — same replacement in MathJax include:

```12:12:/Users/dhruveshpatel/Files/dhruvdcoder.github.io/_includes/scripts/mathjax.html
<script defer src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/polyfill/v3/polyfill.min.js?features=es6"></script>
```

### Needs fix

**iesl-new-website/iesl.github.io** still has the bad script:

```11:11:/Users/dhruveshpatel/Files/IESL/iesl-new-website/iesl.github.io/_includes/scripts/mathjax.html
  <script defer src="https://polyfill.io/v3/polyfill.min.js?features=es6"></script>
```

Replace with:

```html
<script defer src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/polyfill/v3/polyfill.min.js?features=es6"></script>
```

That matches the [polyfill.io auth-dialog issue](https://roboin.io/article/en/2026/06/02/why-some-sites-show-polyfill-io-dialog/) guidance and the al-folio PR. Switch to Agent mode if you want me to apply the change.
